draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher mean test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite, while Arbor-GBT was higher on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1, r2, r4, r5, r6 but lower on r3 (Ivel-Fraud: 92.3 vs 92.8). So "all six" is unsupported; a narrower five-of-six claim is supported. No statistical tests reported, so no significance language.
